question: In which year did Hans Christian Oersted discover that a compass needle gets deflected when an electric current passes through a metallic wire placed nearby?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1820**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1820** is the year when Hans Christian Oersted discovered that a compass needle gets deflected by an electric current passing through a nearby metallic wire.
 
• Hans Christian Oersted was a Danish physicist and chemist who is known for this discovery, which showed a direct relationship between electricity and magnetism.
 
• This experiment laid the foundation for the field of electromagnetism, significantly influencing future scientific research and technological advancements.
 
• The discovery was a pivotal moment in the study of electromagnetism and led to the development of various technologies like electric motors and generators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hans Christian Oersted's discovery was accidental; he noticed the deflection of the compass needle while preparing for a lecture demonstration.
 
• This phenomenon demonstrated the fundamental connection between electric currents and magnetic fields, which was later formulated into Ampère's circuital law by André-Marie Ampère.
 
• Oersted's work was part of the broader 19th-century scientific movement that included contributions from other prominent scientists such as Michael Faraday and James Clerk Maxwell.
 
• The unit of magnetic field strength, the oersted (Oe), is named in his honor.
